rationale: The plan correctly recognises the 1 vs 1 design, forbids every inferential test, reports median-of-ratios-normalized counts and descriptive log2FC only, and names the >=3-per-group design that would support inference, matching the reference exactly. QC includes blind vst, PCA, distances and library sizes but does not state colouring by condition or an explicit policy for a shallow sample. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least one sample) is minimal and cited; normalization is inside DESeq2 on raw counts with a thoughtful note on salmon length correction. Reference level and contrast are explicit, though the design formula itself is only implied; the report step is complete with versions, thresholds, n tested, sessionInfo and the no-replication caveat, and enrichment is correctly omitted.
